lessons.title: The Machine Learning Paradigm
lessons.description: Discover how machine learning differs from traditional programming. Compare Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning.

lessons.title: Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering
lessons.description: Master data preparation: handling missing values, standard vs min-max scaling, categorical encoding, and preventing data leakage.

lessons.title: Linear Regression & Classification
lessons.description: Derive simple linear regression, understand cost functions, transition to logistic regression, and evaluate with confusion matrices.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation & Bias-Variance Tradeoff
lessons.description: Master training/validation/test splits, cross-validation, precision vs recall, underfitting vs overfitting, and regularization techniques.
